title: GEMglFeedbackBuffer

messages.description: maximum number of values that can be written into buffer

arguments.description: maximum number of values that can be written into buffer
what is returned for each vertex, e.g. GL_3D

body: [GEMglFeedbackBuffer] calls glFeedbackBuffer() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glFeedbackBuffer in the OpenGL reference.
